pet0.desc: When Chilly is by your side, you can restore energy once in a while.
notes: When the player is within 3 tiles radius from Chilly, restores 1, 3, or 5 energy.

pet1.desc: Extra coins are occasionally found in battle.
notes: Buddy's attack has 20% chance to cause the target to drop a golden coin, which worths 5 coins.

pet2.desc: If you consume an energy potion when your energy is full, your HP restores by 1.
notes: Hamm restores 1 health to the player when they consume either Energy Pot or Energy Pot L while at full energy.
Using Restoration Potion, Restoration Potion L, Reusable Energy Pot, or Reusable Restoration Potion will not trigger the skill.
The Potion Effectiveness buff has no effect on this skill.

pet3.desc: The slime splits in 2 once it is attacked. It can split up to 2 times. The attack damage of a split is reduced to 1.

pet4.desc: Robo can enhance your armor mount. The max HP of your armor mount increases by 2.

pet5.desc: Monsters find the pet too adorable to attack and so target you instead.
notes: Enemies will not target the pet.

pet6.desc: Fluffy BonBon calms you down. When it is by your side, your weapon accuracy +5.

pet9.desc: Douwa grows big and keeps attacking for a short duration.

pet10.desc: It can dodge attacks from time to time.
notes: The pet's sprite will become invisible with a white outline when doing so.

pet11.desc: It always attacks the enemy furthest from you.

pet12.desc: Baby Seal pats on its belly to remove 1 abnormal status applied to you.

pet13.desc: Enemies are terrified! The bug weakens their desire to attack and the speed of their projectiles.
notes: Reduce enemies' projectiles' velocity by 5 speed units.

pet14.desc: The pet restores its own HP a bit every time it attacks an enemy.

pet15.desc: Pinko Hippo poops every 8 seconds. Enemies who slip on its poo-poo will take 2 damage.

pet16.food: Meat, Grilled Carrot, Grilled Fish, Grilled Green Onion
pet16.desc: Mini Tengu will transform into Great Tengu every once in a while and throw a punch real hard!

pet18.desc: Peanut will deal 1 collision damage to the enemy when it is by your side.

pet20.desc: Enemies that try to approach you will stop moving due to the threats of Smokey.

pet21.desc: When Snow is by your side, you are immune to freeze for a short time.

pet22.desc: With every 20 or more points of energy you have used, Papa restores 0-5 points of energy for you.

pet23.desc: If you consume a health potion when your HP is full, your energy increases by 10.
notes: Maximum energy isn't increases, instead it restores 10 energy.

pet24.desc: You are under the close supervision of Captain Chilly! When it is by your side, your crit hit rate +5.

pet25.desc: Blani burns anywhere that it stays.

pet26.desc: When Speedy's HP is 0, it will shrink into its shell and enter the defense state. In the defense state, Speedy will block any attack like a wall.
notes: Defense state can block allies and enemies projectiles.

pet27.desc: The pet can find cells when it is fighting with the character.

pet28.desc: The pet helps you pick up materials nearby.
notes: The pet can also help to pick up seeds.

pet29.desc: When Pudding is by your side, your movement speed increases for a short duration.

pet30.desc: When Purpur is by your side, you charge much faster.

pet31.desc: The pet inflicts damage to enemies in the circle while knocking them back.

pet32.desc: When your armor is broken, Chestnut will block the projectiles from enemies.

pet34.desc: The pet leaps forward from time to time to create a shockwave.

pet35.desc: After you cast a skill, Rosemary Cat takes a different form and helps you regain energy or armor.

pet36.desc: Purchasing any item with coins in the Level Mode returns 10% of the coins spent.

pet37.desc: Quacky and little ducklings line up and charge at the nearest enemy.
notes: Little ducklings spawn inside the room covered by bubbles, they will pop and follow Quacky when it is nearby.
Each little ducklings cannot be targeted and deals 1 damage each. They will reset after each level but not after clearing each room in that level.

pet38.desc: Sacasaca charges at enemies like a torpedo and ricochets 3 times.

pet39.desc: Mark a random enemy. When defeated within the time limit, the marked enemy randomly drops coins.

pet40.desc: Attacks have a chance to stun enemies.

pet41.desc: At the start of each game, Zongzi Junior gains a random flavor, each offering him a unique effect (for that particular run).Red Bean Delight: Defense +1, HP +2, size increased by 1 time.Salty Egg Surprise: Each attack launches 1 extra projectiles.Meat Feast: Crit hit rate +25%, attack speed +25%, movement speed +25%.Mushroom Magic: Attacks have a 25% chance to trigger a random elemental effect.

pet42.desc: Director Pepper inspires creativity and produces unexpected items during battles.
notes: The items produced can be Carrot, Pill, Retouch-free Camera, Umbrella, poison crates, explosive crates, ice crates, knife crates, 1 energy orb, a bomb (doesn't destroy terrain) and Boar (Mount).
The items can be produced outside battles and in the lobby.

pet43.desc: Pull out a laptop and quickly fix bugs. A successful attempt grants buffs, while a failed one inflicts debuffs.

pet45.desc: Gains bonus to attack speed and movement speed, and fire more projectiles.

pet46.desc: Expands into a medium-sized slime, attacking enemies within a larger area and burning nearby enemies.

pet47.desc: Enters a berserk state, wielding dual AK-47 rifles, gaining a substantial boost to critical hit rate, attack speed, and movement speed.

pet48.desc: Unleash a wild scream, blasting out a shockwave that damages and knocks back all enemies within its area.

pet49.desc: Kapikapi approaches enemies, entering a napping state and taunting nearby enemies in melee range. After taking multiple hits, it enters an enraged state, gaining increased attack speed, movement speed, and critical hit rate.

pet50.desc: Switch to turret mode every 30s, rotating to fire a sweeping laser.

pet51.desc: When your armor is depleted, the Little Drillmaster will pull out his worn bazooka and attack nearby enemies for 5s.

pet52.desc: Toastie ignites itself to launch a barrage of snowballs in all directions, draining health over time until depleted. Snowballs have a chance to freeze enemies.

pet53.desc: Armed with the Marble Blaster, Chilly Cube draws strength from friends to safeguard the Magic Stone.

pet54.desc: When facing powerful foes, Lai Cai will briefly awaken its primal powers, revealing its true form.

pet55.desc: Chilly merges with the summoned mecha to enter an enhanced form. While active, Chilly's movement speed, damage, and size are significantly increased.

pet56.desc: Occasionally takes out the sniper rifle Soul Calibre to attack enemies during combat.
